body:
Part of feature:21d501a74aec4f44.

- On the System Review page the human sets up **several schedules**.
- Each schedule runs a set of review kinds the human chooses. It repeats **daily, weekly or monthly**, or runs at **a specific day and time**.
- A schedule's review runs the same way as a manual one (task:d0d60d7a9688c214).

Ask the human how schedules are listed, added, changed and removed on the page. Nothing else is specified. A review missed while the app was closed is handled by a separate task.

Done when: the human can set up several schedules and each one starts its reviews on time while the app is open.
title: sysreview: scheduled reviews
